name: Half Hollow Hills Community Library (Dix Hills)
aliases: Half Hollow Hills Library Dix Hills

evidence.note: Library calendar: Almost Elton/Almost Billy, Sun Oct 4, 2-3:30 PM, Lecture Room 111 at Dix Hills, registration required.
Adult events page shows the Oct 4 concert as full, with registration closed.

dancing.notes: Library concerts are held in a lecture room with chairs, and you must register ahead. Expect to sit and sing along rather than dance.

description: The Dix Hills branch of the public library serving the Half Hollow Hills area. It hosts free concerts and programs in its lecture room, usually with sign-up required.
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: hhhlibrary.org, portal.suffolklibrarysystem.org, youtube.com, nyslittree.org.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The library also has a Melville branch (510 Sweet Hollow Rd); the Oct 4 concert is at Dix Hills. The show was already full when checked.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The library's robots.txt blocks all crawlers except named search engines (User-agent: * Disallow: /), so we did not fetch its pages directly or download its logo (https://www.hhhlibrary.org/sites/default/files/2020-12/hhh-logo.png) or photos; facts were read from search-engine copies. Owner could request the logo from the library. The YouTube channel has an odd handle (@dblduchess) but its title and content are the library's; it is not linked from the contact page, so treat as medium confidence. No Instagram found. Current description is still accurate. The library also runs a Melville branch (510 Sweet Hollow Rd, 631-421-4535).
hours: Mon-Fri 9:30 AM-9 PM; Sat 9:30 AM-5 PM; Sun 12 PM-5 PM (September-June only)

evidence.note: Library contact page (read via the Bing index): hhhcl@hhhlibrary.org, 631-421-4530 (Dix Hills), 55 Vanderbilt Parkway Dix Hills NY 11746, hours, and links to Facebook /HHHCL and X /HHHCL.
Dix Hills branch page lists the same phone and address and Sunday hours that apply September to June.
Suffolk Cooperative Library System lists the Dix Hills branch at 55 Vanderbilt Parkway with (631) 421-4530 and hhhcl@hhhlibrary.org.
YouTube channel titled Half Hollow Hills Community Library with the library's mission statement and local history videos.
